description: Register an HTTPS webhook for whale-alert deliveries. Registration is x402 paid: $0.100 USDC on Base; each delivered alert accrues $0.02 on the registration. HMAC-SHA256 signed when 'secret' is supplied. List with GET /v1/webhooks/whale-alerts?owner=0x... (free), unregister with DELETE ?token=... (free).

address.description: EVM wallet to watch (from or to)

chain.description: Chain: ethereum, base, arbitrum, polygon, optimism

url.description: HTTPS endpoint that receives alert deliveries

name: cortex_register_whale_webhook
